goal: Prevent signing errors on hardware wallets that lack PSBTv2 support when exporting PSBTs from the GUI
Default to compatible PSBTv0 while letting GUI users choose PSBTv2 when needed
agreement: Blocked by an unaddressed objection on adding UI strings to a backport PR (achow101)
Recommends restricting the GUI to PSBTv0 without adding UI controls for backports (achow101)
Suggests keeping the GUI v0-only and documenting RPC usage for v2 in release notes (Sjors)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because external hardware wallets fail to sign GUI exports when PSBTv2 is used
Resolves widespread hardware signer incompatibility for GUI users exporting transactions
